note: Desktop builds are unsigned preview packages today. Signed/notarized installers land as signing credentials are wired in; this file is regenerated from the release manifests each build.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.openNote: Not yet notarized. After downloading: right-click the app → Open → Open to get past Gatekeeper the first time (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on the .app).

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.openNote: The MSIX is currently unsigned, so Windows rejects a normal double-click install (a code-signing certificate is being obtained). Until then, use the P2P launch path below, or install only if you understand sideloading (Developer Mode + Add-AppxPackage).

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.openNote: After downloading: chmod +x the file and run it. On minimal distributions it may need system GTK4 libraries until runtime bundling lands; on a standard desktop it runs as-is.

p2p.note: Works on every desktop today and hot-syncs the current release from the swarm. Requires the Pear runtime (npm i -g pear). pear run is deprecated in Pear v2.4.0 but still functional.

android.note: A signed .apk for direct download (and a Google Play listing) are in progress.

ios.note: iOS cannot be installed from a download; it will ship via the App Store and TestFlight once review is complete.
